max_lists.title: Lists per customer
max_lists.description: How many named lists one customer (or guest) may keep, the default list included. 1 = a single list.

when_full.title: When a list is full
when_full.description: evict_oldest: adding an item drops the oldest one; refuse: the add is refused (409 limit_reached).

item_url_policy.title: Item links accepted from the page
item_url_policy.description: same_site: only https links on the website's domain; any_https: any https link; none: links are dropped.

image_url_policy.title: Item images accepted from the page
image_url_policy.description: any_https: any https image (CDNs); same_site: only the website's domain; none: images are dropped.

max_writes_per_minute.title: Changes per customer or guest per minute
